quotes.text: Lie prone (on your stomach) on an exercise mat or floor with your elbows close to your sides and directly under your shoulders, palms down and hands facing forward.
quotes.closest: Lie prone (on your stomach) on an exercise mat or floor with your elbows close to your sides and directly under your shoulders, palms down and hands facing forward.

quotes.text: Contract your quadriceps to extend your legs and dorsiflex your ankles (pull toes towards your shins). Contract your core and abdominal muscles to stiffen your torso.
quotes.closest: Contract your quadriceps to extend your legs and dorsiflex your ankles (pull toes towards your shins). Contract your core and abdominal muscles to stiffen your torso.

quotes.text: Slowly lift your entire torso off the floor or mat, maintaining a stiff torso and legs.
quotes.closest: Slowly lift your entire torso off the floor or mat, maintaining a stiff torso and legs.

quotes.text: Avoid any arching (sagging) in your low back, hiking (upwards) in your hips or bending in the knees.
quotes.closest: Avoid any arching (sagging) in your low back, hiking (upwards) in your hips or bending in the knees.

quotes.text: Avoid shrugging your shoulder and keep your shoulders positioned directly over your elbows with your palms facing down.
quotes.closest: Avoid shrugging your shoulder and keep your shoulders positioned directly over your elbows with your palms facing down.

quotes.text: Continue to breath while holding this position for a specified time (5+ seconds).
quotes.closest: Continue to breath while holding this position for a specified time (5+ seconds).

quotes.text: While maintaining a stiff torso and extended knees, gently lower your body back towards the mat or floor before relaxing.
quotes.closest: While maintaining a stiff torso and extended knees, gently lower your body back towards the mat or floor before relaxing.

quotes.text: If you experience any pain in the low back with this movement, stop the exercise immediately and consult with your doctor.
